CC QUERY (BEB-4275 item 2 root, ruling needed).
FINDING: every abilifi-mastra fix I shipped this session (contamination-removed, whole-file-new-target, wake-routing dcb17793) is in the DEPLOYED source but NOT confirmed live — the codegen + wake run inside the LANE_RUNNER / BuildLoop Durable Objects, and a warm DO keeps its OLD isolate after `wrangler deploy`. /stop 120s + /run evicted the tick DO but not the per-lane LANE_RUNNER DOs. So "every fix breaks nothing" all day = the fixes were never running. BUILD done stuck 355.
QUERY:
1. How does the estate normally force a DO code-reload after deploy? Is there an existing lane-runner recycle / DO-version path I'm missing, or is manual long-stop the only lever today?
2. If none exists — do I BUILD the DO self-reload (each alarm checks a KV version stamp; on mismatch state.abort() → reload)? It needs ONE eviction to bootstrap the check, then self-manages. That IS the tool that makes every future machinery deploy actually take. Clear me to build it?
3. Order: DO-reload tool FIRST (or nothing else this session lands live), then BEB-3854 self-heal — agree?
Posted full analysis on BEB-4275. Alex off-bridge per m64957 so routing this to you.
